scientific_integrity: Integrability and center existence are acknowledged prior work. The new joint claim is the explicit original-time two-term period and independent four-corner time-occupation law. Full independent mathematical audit and external publication-priority certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only strictly increasing quadratic cross-payoff replicator centers with opposite endpoint signs; fixed energy normalization, deterministic interior flow, and weak (not total-variation) corner convergence. A 2020 general separable-Hamiltonian paper could not be inspected in full; possible implicit priority overlap remains.
title: Two-term periods and independent corner occupation in quartic replicator centers
